target.route: Final route and completion scope require post-release verification

areas.name: Pre-Release Verification Gate
areas.location_cue: The official product page, platform list, edition table, and release notice.
areas.note: No collectible, ending, calendar, challenge, or location claim is made before the final build exists.

save_backup.title: Archive the offer before expiry
save_backup.why: Storefront availability can change before launch.
save_backup.detail: Keep the receipt, edition listing, region, and cutoff time.

point_of_no_return.title: Availability boundary
point_of_no_return.why: The advertised early-purchase music offer has a real storefront cutoff.
point_of_no_return.detail: Re-check the official product page before acting.

levels.3: Do not start a completion checklist until the final global build can be inspected on or after February 18, 2027. Re-fetch official materials, patch notes, and in-game menus before replacing this holding row.

levels.1: PC is the likely fidelity route.
levels.2: Windows and Steam are announced alongside current consoles.
levels.3: Treat Windows as provisional only. At release, compare content, patch parity, performance, save behavior, language support, and any platform-exclusive items before locking Sami's route.

levels.1: Edition extras require a launch-day inventory.
levels.2: The Digital Premium edition advertises costume, Persona, and music sets.
levels.3: Before purchase, list every separately sold and edition-locked gameplay item. Verify whether the four Persona sets alter the registry and whether the Velvet costume remains edition-exclusive; do not count physical merchandise as game completion.

levels.1: One announced bonus has a purchase cutoff.
levels.2: The extra P3R/P5R music set is tied to early purchase.
levels.3: If Sami wants the archival audio set, confirm the local storefront deadline and purchase eligibility before February 18, 2027. The bonus is optional music, not a routine completion failure after expiry.

areas.name: Post-Release Rebuild Checklist
areas.location_cue: The final title screen, calendar, exploration maps, compendium, social menus, inventory, and clear data.
areas.note: Every row here is a research gate, not an invented in-game task.

levels.1: Inspect the game itself before writing.
levels.2: Inventory every ending, rescue window, bond, Persona, request, book, activity, meal, equipment row, costume, challenge, and restart feature.
levels.3: On the final patched build, record every finite menu and branch from direct play. Compare it with official materials and independent references, then write new fact notes with source pages closed.

levels.1: The remake changes more than presentation.
levels.2: Verify new scenes, voiced bonds, guarding, knockback, Baton Pass, and Prime Time directly.
levels.3: Build the Revival checklist from its own final systems. Never copy Persona 4 Golden's dates, dungeon rules, items, endings, or compendium denominator without in-game confirmation.

levels.1: No final geometry means no honest sketch.
levels.2: Create zero location images before release.
levels.3: After direct final-build footage or verified location facts exist, draw original perpendicular item scenes or orthographic room schematics. Until then, keep every entry text-only and do not adapt trailer frames.

levels.1: The real pack must pass every existing checker.
levels.2: Require schema validation, a fetched prose corpus, zero eight-word copied runs, and honest image provenance.
levels.3: Rebuild this holding pack after launch, validate with compile_pack.py, run verify_no_verbatim.py against the fetched local corpus, inspect a contact sheet, and retain DO_NOT_SHIP until Sami reviews it.
